name: goldie
title_zh: 重放 App 操作录屏，套上真实商店页边框和文案
tagline_zh: 回放 argent 流程录屏，给截图套机身边框、配底色和文案，出 4~5 张成品加一段预览视频，本地起个 studio 按真实商店页排给你看。
tagline_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
desc_en: Replays argent flows, frames the captures with a device bezel, background and copy, and opens a local studio laid out as the real store page.
why_zh: 预览视频它坚持交原始录屏不加边框字幕——因为苹果就是这么要求的，它没替你「美化」成会被打回的东西。
why_en: It insists the preview video stays a plain screen recording — because Apple requires that — instead of prettifying it into something that gets rejected.
limit_zh: 要在这个 App 自己的仓里跑，且要有 iOS 模拟器或安卓模拟器。挑哪几屏值得营销、写流程、写文案还是你的活，它只负责跑和渲。studio 起在 localhost:4321，视频在后台渲。
limit_en: Run it from the mobile app's own repo with a simulator available. Choosing which screens to market, authoring the flows and writing the copy stay yours.
title_en: Replay app flows, framed in a real store page mockup
